next_catalyst.what: Phase 2 FREEDOM2 data from the 10 mg/kg multiple ascending dose cohort of PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1)
next_catalyst.quote: The Company is actively dosing the 10 mg/kg MAD cohort of FREEDOM2, with 5 of 8 patients receiving up to three doses of PGN-EDODM1, and expects to report data in the second half of 2026.
